name: Princess Protocol
source:
You've just split with your husband after almost ten years of marriage. A relationship influencer who couldn't keep her own relationship afloat - what a joke! Your personal and professional lives are both a mess... and this is not where you wanted to end up at 36. 

While you're spiraling, your college friend begs you to join her reality TV dating show, and in a drunken stupor, you agree. Unfortunately, you get branded as the old, sad divorcée. And, even worse, the bachelor turns out to be someone you're not on great terms with. Your producer doesn't seem to like you much, either.

At this point, all you want to do is survive this nightmare.

[From [url=https://chattercap.itch.io/princess-protocol]itch.io[/url]]
